title: Vibra static effect surface
description: The effect surface of a program, derived from declared effect rows rather than from a call-graph walk. Declarations are checked against inference during lowering, so `effects` is exact rather than an approximation. Breaking change from effects.schema.json, whose single `effects` array is now `host-imports`.

effects.description: Every effect reachable from the entry point: what this program can do.

functions.description: Per-function declared rows, for auditing which part of the program is responsible for each effect. Functions declaring no effects are omitted.

host-imports.description: The reachable host-import surface beneath the declared rows.

effects.description: The effects the ABI registry declares for this import.

effect.description: An effect label, identified structurally by its domain and action rather than by any name bound to it.
